question: You're mapping a Player hierarchy (Footballer, Cricketer, Bowler) to the database. A DBA asks why you'd put all of them in one players table. Give Fowler's strengths and weaknesses of Single Table Inheritance and name the alternatives.

cases.answer: One table, no joins to load any player, and moving fields up or down the hierarchy needs no schema change. Downsides: subclass-only columns confuse people using the table directly and waste space, the table can get big with many indexes and lock contention, and there's a single namespace for column names. Alternatives are Class Table Inheritance and Concrete Table Inheritance, and you can mix them within one hierarchy.
must_credit: single table, no joins, refactoring fields needs no DB change
irrelevant columns, wasted space, large table/locking, one namespace
alternatives: Class Table and Concrete Table Inheritance
